what: The whole panel is clipped on the right: the caption, both programs, both terminals and the three-item readlist run 77px past the panel edge and are cut off mid-word ("Scoot searches 3 shelves with 3 slots each f…", "It leaves only the innermost loop, the o…").
evidence: Crop /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-6-10/evidence/ch6-p22-390.png. Measured: p.caption, div.pair and ol.readlist each end 77px beyond the panel box at 390 (document scrollWidth unchanged, so check_chapter.js still PASSes). Cause: ch6 uses <div class="pair"> (P21, P22, P36) but go-ch6.css has no .pair rule (ch7-10 copy one) and the engine defines .pair only inside .page-body, so the div is a grid item with min-width:auto and grows to the longest code line. At 1280 the same pair silently stacks instead of sitting side by side (/tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-6-10/evidence/ch6-p22-1280.png).
fix: Before: no `.pair` rule in go-ch6.css → After: `.pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 300px), 1fr)); gap: 12px; align-items: start; } .pair > * { min-width: 0; }` (why: a grid child must be allowed to shrink below its longest line; keep the children display:block, see the go/ch7 file-tab finding). Better: promote `.pair` into comic-widgets.css (INTEGRATION_TODO [ch7] .pair item).
